en: Old black‑and‑white riverfront view showing several paddle steamers and barges moored along a quay. Behind them stands a long, continuous row of ornate late‑19th‑century apartment or office blocks with mansard roofs, domes, and decorative facades. In front of the buildings is a tree‑lined embankment with a tram or streetcar running along it. The overall appearance suggests a European capital city in the early 20th century.
